name: 🚓 Turbo City: Cops & Robbers
description: Welcome to TURBO CITY! Drive 9 cool cars, buy houses, take jobs and choose your side: become a COP and catch robbers with your Stun Blaster, or a ROBBER and grab loot at the Bank, Gem Store, Gas 'n' Go and Donut Palace, then race to the HIDEOUT! Deliver packages, win city races, hit boost strips and jump pads, upgrade from a Trailer to a Mega Mansion and earn rent every minute. New daily missions, daily rewards and playtime gifts. NEW: levels, trophies and titles, a free daily Lucky Wheel, car tuning, the Armored Truck heist, city events, speed cams, hidden Turbo Tokens and a minimap! Play with friends for +10% cash each! Codes: TURBO, RELEASE
